tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All the terms and conditions to be followed as per the tender document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The OEM/Bidder should have an experience of executing and maintaining LAN Works, CCTV work, Command Centre, Audio Visual System in Government Sector i.e. Public Sector Undertakings, Autonomous Bodies, Research and Educational Institutions etc. The vendor should have proof of executing one such LAN work minimum extent of Rs.25 Lakhs in any one of the 03 (Three) financial years (2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-26). Proof of the same shall be submitted.

The OEM/ bidder should be a registered company / Partnership firm under Companies Act, 2013 / the Indian Partnership Act, 1932. Should enclose attested photocopy of such certificates with their Bid. The OEM/Bidder should be in line of business for at least minimum of 5(Five) years or above in Karnataka with registered Regional Office/Head Office

The OEM/bidder must have an office in Bangalore, Karnataka. OEM/ bidder should enclose attested copies of Property tax bill/ Lease agreement, Electricity Bill, Telephone Bill, GST Registration and PAN as proof of the office address
The OEM / Bidder should be an Authorized System Integrator having a direct purchase and support agreement with the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) for Network active components
The Vendor should have Service Center operating in Bangalore. (Communication address, technician details, telephone number including mobile no. should be provided).

The vendor company should have annual turnover of Rs.100 lakhs or above from businesses relating to sales and support for Networking Systems, Computer Hardware in India during all the 3 financial years (2023-24,2024-25 & 2025-26). Bidder should furnish copies of audited balance sheets for the last 3 financial years (2023-24,2024-25 & 2025-26) in support of annual turnover or Certificates issued by Chartered Accountant
